threshold.criterion_1: every landscape reproduces exactly from its seed
threshold.criterion_2: NK at K = 0 equals additive to 1e-12
threshold.criterion_3: local optima rise and correlation length falls with K, in the seed mean, at L = 10 and L = 12

notes: The optimum survey is the ADR-0011 requirement applied to all seven families. A family whose global optimum wanders away from the master sequence as ruggedness rises cannot carry an error-threshold statement, because the threshold is defined by delocalisation away from that sequence.
